correctness.rationale: PASS — For every q,k≥1 and each marked set M (including empty), collapsing all unused letters to * gives an equitable in/out-degree counting partition, so stable color cannot be finer than the coordinate pattern. Directly expanded F and B shift adjacency to establish B^(k−j)F^(k−1)B^(i−1)e_r=q^(i−1+k−j) 1_{v_j=r_i}. Since marked singleton indicators are present initially and F,B each advance one refinement round, all named-letter coordinate tests are visible by round ≤3k−3, forcing the reverse partition inclusion. Aut of directed de Bruijn graph acts by simultaneous S_q letter permutations; its marker stabilizer is S_u, and equality patterns of h unused positions give Σ_b Stirling(h,b) orbits per cell. Exactness iff k=1 or u≤1; q=1,k=1, M=∅ and loops covered. Independently enumerated 20 marked refinements and compared induced partitions, plus direct symbolic operator argument; finite checks do not prove all q,k.
